en.text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.

zhSimplified.text: 论埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和华乘驾快云， 临到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前战兢； 埃及人的心在里面消化。

zhTraditional.text: 論埃及的默示： 看哪，耶和華乘駕快雲， 臨到埃及。 埃及的偶像在他面前戰兢； 埃及人的心在裏面消化。

en.text: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 我必激动埃及人攻击埃及人— 弟兄攻击弟兄， 邻舍攻击邻舍； 这城攻击那城， 这国攻击那国。

zhTraditional.text: 我必激動埃及人攻擊埃及人－ 弟兄攻擊弟兄， 鄰舍攻擊鄰舍； 這城攻擊那城， 這國攻擊那國。

en.text: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及人的心神必在里面耗尽； 我必败坏他们的谋略。 他们必求问偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫术的。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及人的心神必在裏面耗盡； 我必敗壞他們的謀略。 他們必求問偶像和念咒的、 交鬼的、行巫術的。

en.text: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.

footnotes.text: 19:4 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 我必将埃及人交在残忍主的手中； 强暴王必辖制他们。 这是主—万军之耶和华说的。

zhTraditional.text: 我必將埃及人交在殘忍主的手中； 強暴王必轄制他們。 這是主－萬軍之耶和華說的。

en.text: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

zhSimplified.text: 海中的水必绝尽， 河也消没干涸。

zhTraditional.text: 海中的水必絕盡， 河也消沒乾涸。

en.text: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

zhSimplified.text: 江河要变臭； 埃及的河水都必减少枯干。 苇子和芦荻都必衰残；

zhTraditional.text: 江河要變臭； 埃及的河水都必減少枯乾。 葦子和蘆荻都必衰殘；

en.text: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

zhSimplified.text: 靠尼罗河旁的草田， 并沿尼罗河所种的田，都必枯干。 庄稼被风吹去，归于无有。

zhTraditional.text: 靠尼羅河旁的草田， 並沿尼羅河所種的田，都必枯乾。 莊稼被風吹去，歸於無有。

en.text: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

zhSimplified.text: 打鱼的必哀哭。 在尼罗河一切钓鱼的必悲伤； 在水上撒网的必都衰弱。

zhTraditional.text: 打魚的必哀哭。 在尼羅河一切釣魚的必悲傷； 在水上撒網的必都衰弱。

en.text: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

zhSimplified.text: 用梳好的麻造物的 和织白布的都必羞愧；

zhTraditional.text: 用梳好的麻造物的 和織白布的都必羞愧；

en.text: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

zhSimplified.text: 国柱必被打碎， 所有佣工的，心必愁烦。

zhTraditional.text: 國柱必被打碎， 所有傭工的，心必愁煩。

en.text: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?

zhSimplified.text: 琐安的首领极其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的谋士， 所筹划的成为愚谋。 你们怎敢对法老说： 我是智慧人的子孙， 我是古王的后裔？

zhTraditional.text: 瑣安的首領極其愚昧； 法老大有智慧的謀士， 所籌劃的成為愚謀。 你們怎敢對法老說： 我是智慧人的子孫， 我是古王的後裔？

en.text: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

zhSimplified.text: 你的智慧人在哪里呢？ 万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意， 他们可以知道，可以告诉你吧！

zhTraditional.text: 你的智慧人在哪裏呢？ 萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意， 他們可以知道，可以告訴你吧！

en.text: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

zhSimplified.text: 琐安的首领都变为愚昧； 挪弗的首领都受了迷惑。 当埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走错了路。

zhTraditional.text: 瑣安的首領都變為愚昧； 挪弗的首領都受了迷惑。 當埃及支派房角石的， 使埃及人走錯了路。

en.text: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使乖谬的灵搀入埃及中间； 首领使埃及一切所做的都有差错， 好像醉酒之人呕吐的时候东倒西歪一样。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使乖謬的靈攙入埃及中間； 首領使埃及一切所做的都有差錯， 好像醉酒之人嘔吐的時候東倒西歪一樣。

en.text: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

zhSimplified.text: 埃及中，无论是头与尾， 棕枝与芦苇，所做之工都不成就。

zhTraditional.text: 埃及中，無論是頭與尾， 棕枝與蘆葦，所做之工都不成就。

en.text: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.

zhSimplified.text: 到那日，埃及人必像妇人一样，他们必因万军之耶和华在埃及以上所抡的手，战兢惧怕。

zhTraditional.text: 到那日，埃及人必像婦人一樣，他們必因萬軍之耶和華在埃及以上所掄的手，戰兢懼怕。

en.text: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大地必使埃及惊恐，向谁提起犹大地，谁就惧怕。这是因万军之耶和华向埃及所定的旨意。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大地必使埃及驚恐，向誰提起猶大地，誰就懼怕。這是因萬軍之耶和華向埃及所定的旨意。

en.text: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

zhSimplified.text: 当那日，埃及地必有五城的人说迦南的方言，又指着万军之耶和华起誓。有一城必称为「灭亡城」。

zhTraditional.text: 當那日，埃及地必有五城的人說迦南的方言，又指着萬軍之耶和華起誓。有一城必稱為「滅亡城」。

en.text: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.

zhSimplified.text: 当那日，在埃及地中必有为耶和华筑的一座坛；在埃及的边界上必有为耶和华立的一根柱。

zhTraditional.text: 當那日，在埃及地中必有為耶和華築的一座壇；在埃及的邊界上必有為耶和華立的一根柱。

en.text: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

zhSimplified.text: 这都要在埃及地为万军之耶和华作记号和证据。埃及人因为受人的欺压哀求耶和华，他就差遣一位救主作护卫者，拯救他们。

zhTraditional.text: 這都要在埃及地為萬軍之耶和華作記號和證據。埃及人因為受人的欺壓哀求耶和華，他就差遣一位救主作護衛者，拯救他們。

en.text: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必被埃及人所认识。在那日，埃及人必认识耶和华，也要献祭物和供物敬拜他，并向耶和华许愿还愿。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必被埃及人所認識。在那日，埃及人必認識耶和華，也要獻祭物和供物敬拜他，並向耶和華許願還願。

en.text: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必击打埃及，又击打又医治，埃及人就归向耶和华。他必应允他们的祷告，医治他们。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必擊打埃及，又擊打又醫治，埃及人就歸向耶和華。他必應允他們的禱告，醫治他們。

en.text: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

zhSimplified.text: 当那日，必有从埃及通亚述去的大道。亚述人要进入埃及，埃及人也进入亚述；埃及人要与亚述人一同敬拜耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 當那日，必有從埃及通亞述去的大道。亞述人要進入埃及，埃及人也進入亞述；埃及人要與亞述人一同敬拜耶和華。

en.text: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

zhSimplified.text: 当那日，以色列必与埃及、亚述三国一律，使地上的人得福；

zhTraditional.text: 當那日，以色列必與埃及、亞述三國一律，使地上的人得福；

en.text: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为万军之耶和华赐福给他们，说：「埃及—我的百姓，亚述—我手的工作，以色列—我的产业，都有福了！」

zhTraditional.text: 因為萬軍之耶和華賜福給他們，說：「埃及－我的百姓，亞述－我手的工作，以色列－我的產業，都有福了！」
